description: 5 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored when the ADR location fix brought this skill into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover the four document shapes the skill writes (technical spec, PRD, RFC, ADR) and a German phrasing. Near-misses are the neighbours its Do-NOT-use list names (implementation work, feature planning) plus emitting tickets from a finished plan. Counterexamples guard the word 'spec' in a test-file sense and an unrelated writing task.

queries.q: write a technical specification for the new billing export service
draft a PRD for the onboarding checklist — users are dropping off at step two
we need an RFC on switching the queue backend before the team reviews it
document this significant change as a spec with goals and non-goals
schreib eine technische Spezifikation für den neuen Import-Service
implement the export service described in the spec
queries.note: implementation work, which this skill's Do-NOT-use list routes to feature-planning or php-coder

queries.q: break this feature into a step-by-step implementation plan
queries.note: planning the build rather than documenting the design → feature-planning

queries.q: turn the approved spec's roadmap into tickets
queries.note: the spec already exists; materialising work items → emit-tickets

queries.q: fix the failing spec file in tests/Unit/InvoiceSpec.php
queries.note: the 'spec' homonym — a test file, not a design document

queries.q: write a friendly welcome email for new users
queries.note: unrelated writing; guards against triggering on 'write' alone
